notes: Lethal weapon curve: every firearm, unique and melee weapon is scored by expected damage per turn over a full reload cycle (one attack per turn, reload = Action +2 / Bonus +1, vs AC 14 at +5) and outliers beyond +/-15% are pulled onto one curve: ~14-16 per turn for street gear (street pistols ~24 per hit), ~26 mid tier, ~50 top tier; melee +15%, uniques +10%. Dice scale within their die type; magazines, reloads and every manufacturer trait unchanged.

Big single-shot snipers keep extreme alpha: Nekomata 6d20+75, Sunlance 1d20+114, Grad 1d20+74, Rasetsu 7d20+26. Black Requiem and Silverhand 3516 unchanged. Errata 16d8, Chainsword Legendary 12d10, Neurotoxin Knife 6d6 + poison.
Prices follow power: power ratings re-derived from final damage; price = 150 + 7 x rating^1.75 (x rarity multiplier).
Armor AC, prices and Bastion reduction unchanged (high AC is the intended counterweight to lethal guns). Flexweave Grenade Null halves grenade damage at Mk I-IV, immunity at Mk V.
Grenades: damage by Mk (Mk1 6d6, Mk2 8d6, Mk3 10d6, Mk4 12d6; EMP one step lighter; Ozob's Nose 15d6 at 1750 CR); prices by Mk with sticky x1.3, homing x1.6, utility x0.4.
Quickhacks: Arc Overload 12d12 -> 10d10. Consumables: Neural Adaptation Kit once per character (GM-enforced text).
Joke weapons (Slaughtomatic, Dildo Stout, Shovel Caretaker) and all cyberware untouched.
